summary: The task analysis packet for P1.A2 is well-defined, adhering to ADR-043 and ADR-038. The scope is strictly bounded to transient synthetic seed storage with clear isolation of the proof-root directory. The design correctly addresses the critical "close-before-delete" requirement and implements necessary safety bounds for the janitor to prevent accidental data loss outside the designated cache path. Test coverage requirements for failure modes (traversal, write/hash, and cleanup) are comprehensive.
